criteria.change: No vision-level change required; keep the two-interface vocabulary (lifted oracle vs quantum action) verbatim in both specs so the slogan and the semantics cannot drift apart in design.
criteria.evidence: §0's qualified thesis, the ten decisions, §4.2's two region interfaces with total oracles and fault register, and rungs 4/7/8 describe one system: inferred-taint reversibilisation of unmodified LLVM programs onto a public virtual ISA. Ambition (controlled-anything, Grover over unmodified SQLite, kernel as oracle) and the totality/fault discipline now support rather than contradict each other.

criteria.change: No vision-level change required; in the dialect spec, close the materialiser's definition with an enumerated list of poison/undef sources it eliminates or rejects (poison literals, noundef and range attributes, fast-math nnan/ninf flags, poison-generating intrinsics and vector lanes) plus a residual-poison validator, so 'poison-free form' is checkable rather than aspirational.
criteria.evidence: The load-bearing premises are now true: external effectful marker functions instead of plugin-registered llvm.* intrinsics, with positive legality stated as a property of ordinary opaque calls; portable AS0/integer handles with fail-loud rejection of memory/inttoptr flow; CodeExtractor regions at link time; C++-only analyses confined to the one LLVM-linked compiler-core component. §3.2's materialised normalisation (strip poison flags, totalise shifts via select, zero-initialise allocas/heap/padding/inputs, replace residual undef) is a sound refinement on defined executions and, unlike freeze, gives the bitcode one meaning that both native codegen and the ISA interpreter implement; freezing the dialect spec is gated on the O3 legality corpus and real clang/rustc/Julia emission.

criteria.change: Add one sentence pinning the budget semantics of a quantum action whose own control is coherent: either the action is defined as exactly the bounded, padded unitary of its reference step machine (budget part of its identity, recorded in the certificate), or admission requires budget-adequacy evidence and fails loud without it — so no action can be silently truncated the way an oracle without its fault register could.
criteria.evidence: §4.1–§4.3 articulate the missing layer precisely: virtual qubits with allocation classes and dirty borrowing, classical region budgets chosen at run time, the predicated step machine as the general construction for arbitrary post-O3 CFGs with pred/loop as specialiser optimisations, padded costs and O(N) quantum addressing stated honestly, exit synchronisation to a common halt counter, and the circuit executor as exactly the VM under a fixed budget. Garbage is a scheduled resource inside the Silq/Unqomp validity envelope, and oracle (F_B, XOR, self-adjoint, fault register) and quantum-action (U on mutable wires, ctrl-U, U†) interfaces are finally kept apart by name.

criteria.change: No vision-level change required; in design, run the competitor-replacement test over the binary edges (plugin↔sched, driver↔plugin) as §6.1 now promises, not only over the document edges.
criteria.evidence: §4.4 and §6.1 enumerate every cross-repository artefact — object/link formats, reversible ABI, launch ABI including the host-effect/handle split, scheduling interface with C ABI and objective semantics, certificate and coverage-report formats — under exactly two contracts, with ISA sub-artefacts versioned independently and a dialect reference semantics into the ISA formal model. The one scheduler is shared by specification behind a substitutable interface, not by code; no monolith remains hidden.

criteria.change: Name the supported idiom for collections of qubit handles (statically indexed aggregates resolved at outlining, or a classical-control handle table owned by the launch ABI), since arrays/structs of qubits are the first thing real quantum code writes and today read as fail-loud rejects under the handle-through-memory rule.
criteria.evidence: 'Any LLVM language, no fork' is credible as stated: the universal requirement is only bitcode emission, 'unmodified' is defined as no source edits with flags/shims recorded, per-front-end costs are named (rustc bitcode extraction or -Zbuild-std, Julia via LLVM.jl, mixed majors only inside a tested envelope), exceptions/unwinding are assigned step-machine or fault semantics, and handle-touching code is placed in the device classical-control tier with the host split owned by the launch ABI.

criteria.change: No vision-level change required; keep fault-register and dirty-ancilla values inside domain D in every downstream conformance artefact so the full-tuple check cannot regress to output-only comparison.
criteria.evidence: §5.1 defines correctness exactly: the permutation tier is fixed after decomposition to emitted gates, verified by equality of the entire final tuple |x⟩|t⊕payload⟩|e⊕code⟩|d⟩|0⟩ over a finite D including fault and dirty values, with exhaustive agreement complete for D and sampling labelled evidence; budgets counted in reference-interpreter steps make the fault set a property of program+budget+recorded LLVM pipeline, never of Bennett's lowering. Non-permutation lowerings get diamond-norm channel comparison and controlled-interference tests with composition rules, dirty-pool tractability is by structural frame lemma or labelled evidence, and every rung is ordered, measurable, and requires zero fault rate for the interference reason §4.2 states.

criteria.change: No vision-level change required; preserve the narrow (a)–(d) novelty wording in derivative documents so adopted mechanisms are not later re-claimed as new.
criteria.evidence: §7 credits and correctly differentiates Enzyme, PTX/offload, Knill/Quil/eQASM, QIR (faulted precisely on ownership and front-end-emitted adjoints), OpenQASM 3, CUDA-Q/Quake, Catalyst/MLIR/Qrisp, Q#, Quipper, Silq/Unqomp/Reqomp/SQUARE with the validity invariant adopted, the Quantum Control Machine, QCOR/XACC, tweedledum/RevKit, ProjectQ, REVS, Tower/Spire, Qualtran/Azure with a unit-reconciliation rule, QSSA/QIRO and now HUGR/Guppy/tket2 as an import door, ReVerC, and the pebbling literature including its PSPACE hardness. Nothing claimed new is prior art under scrutiny; the novelty is the combination, claimed as such.

criteria.change: Promote two §9.11 items to one-sentence vision contracts where they are used: the memory-ordering assumption for atomics/volatile in lifted code (sequentialised on a recorded schedule, matching the single-threaded native oracle) and the floating-point determinism contract (defined rounding/NaN semantics the interpreter and soft-float library implement), since SQLite, the kernel, and the Monte Carlo all exercise them.
criteria.evidence: Each reader can act: a vendor gets the ISA, target-description, scheduling-interface and conformance contracts; a language designer gets the portable marker ABI, legality requirement, and copy/XOR/total-bijection rules; a compiler engineer gets pipeline placement, materialised normalisation, the two interfaces, validity invariants, and per-front-end costs. §9 defers mechanics (fat-object layout, fault-code enumeration, serialisation, MBU-under-control certificate form with unitary fallback already named) rather than load-bearing semantics; what remains under-specified is at spec-example level, not vision level.

path_to_accept: No changes are required for accept; the blocking list is empty. To raise the lowest-scoring criteria (C3, C5, C8 at 4) by one point, add three short normative sentences, mirrored in the specs: (i) a quantum action with coherent internal control is either defined as its bounded padded reference unitary or admitted only with budget-adequacy evidence, failing loud otherwise; (ii) the supported idiom for statically indexed collections of qubit handles; (iii) the atomic/volatile sequentialisation assumption and the floating-point determinism contract for lifted code. These are pins for the design phase, not changes of direction.
suggestions: State the quantum-action budget rule explicitly (bounded-unitary-by-definition vs budget-adequacy obligation), and extend §3.1's 'unitary uncomputation fallback under control' to say 'under control and adjoint' until the §9.6 certificate kind exists (§§3.1, 4.2).

In bennett-dialect-spec, enumerate every poison/undef source the materialiser eliminates or rejects — poison literals, noundef/range attributes, fast-math nnan/ninf, poison-generating intrinsics, undef vector lanes — and ship a residual-poison validator so the normaliser's output property is mechanically checked (§3.2).

Clarify that zero-initialisation of region-input padding is an entry encoding realised unitarily (masked workspace copy, physical input wires preserved), with domain D stated over those encodings, so no reader implements it as overwriting a caller's wires (§§3.2, 5.1).

Carry the worked examples codex asked for into the dialect spec as planned: one faulting oracle under control and adjoint, one non-self-inverse quantum action (RZ) with an in-place increment, one controlled in-place bijection at a width with unused encodings.
Define the handle-collection idiom for v1 (statically indexed aggregates or a launch-ABI handle table) so ordinary qubit-array code has a stated path instead of only a stated rejection (§3.1).

Note in §5.1 that native execution supplies success values and that fault causes/codes come from the checked reference interpreter, since a native trap cannot distinguish division-by-zero from unreachable or a faulting access.
summary: All round-4 blocking issues are resolved and none is re-raised. Codex B_FREEZE_DETERMINISM and opus B1_FREEZE_REFINEMENT_NOT_NATIVE are resolved: §3.2 abandons freeze for materialised normalisation (option A from both members) — poison flags stripped, partial operations totalised with stated results, allocas/heap/padding/inputs zero-initialised, residual undef replaced — with the native comparison binary and the reference interpreter both built from that materialised bitcode, so F_B has one defined meaning and only encountered immediate UB remains, as a fault code under a recorded definedness assumption and LLVM pipeline. Codex B1_QUANTUM_STATE_WRITE_SEMANTICS is resolved: §4.2 now separates the lifted classical oracle (F_B, XOR accumulation, inputs preserved, self-adjoint, fault register) from the quantum action (unitary U on declared mutable wires, borrowed inputs preserved, workspace restored, ctrl-U and U†, no fault of its own, fallible work delegated to nested oracles whose fault registers it declares), with region-exit synchronisation stated. Codex B_INPLACE_BOUNDED_INVERSE is resolved by the minimal design: __bennett_inplace is admitted only for mutually inverse total bijections on a declared finite encoding with budgets sufficient for forward and inverse evaluation, fallible computation is never in-place, library modular multiplication states coprimality and unused-encoding treatment, and g∘ginv=id is a checked obligation whose failure leaves scratch non-clean. Re-grading from scratch, I found no false technical premise, internal contradiction, or missing load-bearing piece that would make the project build the wrong thing; the residuals (action budget wording, poison-source enumeration, handle collections, FP/atomic contracts) are spec-level pins recorded as suggestions. The vision is unreasonably ambitious, right, and stated precisely enough for strangers to build from.
